# mizchi-blog-style

> Japanese style guide and AI-tone rubric for mizchi-authored blog posts (zenn / dev.to), calibrated on 18 articles / 937 sentences / 766 paragraphs. Scores a draft structure-first — paragraph granularity, heading form, code cadence, closing move — because marker rates (口語・文末・自分) can be hit exactly while the text still reads as pastiche. Use after drafting an article during the style-matching revision loop.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/mizchi-blog-style
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/mizchi-blog-style
```

then run `apm install`.
